name: Getsumei no Nokiera
source:
In a different world where there is a war between humans and monsters, humans established an organization called the "Church."

In order to fight against monsters, the Church succeeded in creating human "angels" who have magical powers built in like monsters.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9693]NovelGame[/url]]
